back_translation: But now, thus says the LORD who created you, O Jacob, and who formed you, O Israel: "Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine.

When you wade across the waters, I will be with you; and when you cross the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through fire, you will not be burned, and the flame will not consume you.
For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I give Egypt as your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
Because you are precious in My eyes, you are honored and I love you, I will give men in your place and nations in exchange for your life.
Do not fear, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
I will say to the north, 'Release them!' and to the south, 'Do not hold them back!' Bring My sons from afar and My daughters from the ends of the earth —
everyone who is called by My name, whom I created for My glory, whom I formed and made."
Bring out the people who have eyes but are blind, who have ears but are deaf.

Let all the nations assemble and the peoples gather together. Who among them can declare this and announce to us the former things? Let them bring their witnesses to prove themselves right, so that others may hear and say, "It is true."

"You are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me there will be none.
I — I Myself — am the LORD, and apart from Me there is no Savior at all.
I Myself declared and saved and proclaimed — I, and not some foreign god among you. Therefore you are My witnesses," declares the LORD, "and I am God.
From eternity I am He; no one can rescue out of My hand. When I act, who can turn it back?"
Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon and bring them all down as fugitives, including the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they took pride.
I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King."
Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters,
who brings out chariot and horse, army and warrior together — they lie down and do not rise again; they are extinguished like a lamp-wick snuffed out:
"Do not remember the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
Behold, I am doing a new thing; now it is springing up. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the wasteland.
The wild animals of the field will honor Me — the jackals and the ostriches — because I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the wasteland, for My people, My chosen, to drink.
The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise."
"Yet you have not called on Me, O Jacob, because you have grown weary of Me, O Israel.
You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored Me with your sacrifices. I did not burden you with grain offerings, nor weary you with incense.
You did not buy Me fragrant cane with your silver, nor satisfy Me with the fat of your sacrifices. Instead you have burdened Me with your sins and wearied Me with your iniquities.
I — I Myself — am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake, and I will remember your sins no more.
Remind Me — let us contend together. State your case, so that you may be proved right.
Your first father sinned, and your spokesmen rebelled against Me.
Therefore I disgraced the princes of the sanctuary, and I gave Jacob over to complete destruction and Israel to mockery."
